description: Fetch a researcher's public profile from ORCID: name, other names, biography, keywords, researcher URLs, and external identifiers such as Scopus Author ID, ResearcherID, and Loop profile. This is the entry point for building a researcher dossier. Pass a bare ORCID iD (0000-0001-2345-6789) or a full URI (https://orcid.org/0000-0001-2345-6789). The profile contains only publicly visible data — researchers control visibility per field.

orcid_id.description: ORCID iD — bare (0000-0001-2345-6789) or as an orcid.org URI (https://orcid.org/0000-0001-2345-6789). The check digit may be X or x.

name: orcid_get_profile

countries.description: Countries listed in the researcher's address section.

primary.description: True when this is the primary email address.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `profile_not_found`: The ORCID iD does not correspond to a registered researcher. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

externalIdentifiers.description: External identifiers from scholarly systems (Scopus, Web of Science, Loop, etc.).

items.description: External identifier linking to another scholarly system.

type.description: Identifier type (e.g. Scopus Author ID, ResearcherID, Loop).

url.description: Resolver URL for this identifier, if provided.

keywords.description: Research keywords set by the researcher.

notice.description: Names the profile sections with no public data — ORCID visibility is set per field, so an empty section may be private.

orcidId.description: Normalized ORCID iD (bare format without URI prefix).

otherNames.description: Other names listed on the ORCID record.

researcherUrls.description: Researcher-provided URLs (personal site, lab page, blog, etc.).

title: Get ORCID Researcher Profile
